timing: Taxonomy developed after VPS005 outcome inspection, before MTA006 aggregate inspection; post hoc explanatory description, not an additional primary endpoint or hypothesis test.
limits: Equal group counts do not imply the same covered groups or selected terms.
A proxy-group member can be an exact false inclusion, and a redundant same-group member can be a group false inclusion under one-to-one scoring.
same_covered_groups describes the entire selected support; it need not mean a single pure proxy-for-proxy swap.
No causal or predictive equivalence follows from oracle grouping.
